lesson_title: A Closing Stage's Tooling May Sit Outside What CI Runs
rationale: The change affects the project's architectural structure by moving critical path code (Stage 18 tooling) from a legacy location (pmbok/) to the maintained codebase (src/agent_learning/pmbok/). This requires updates to multiple interconnected components including source code, tests, CI configuration, and architectural decisions (ADR-034). The evidence basis is 'execution' as this was discovered through the execution of Stage 15 lessons learned from INSIGHT-003 (derived from OBS-002, OBS-006, OBS-009).
decision: Classify LL-043 as structural/architectural diff requiring Steering Committee approval

evidence.lesson_text: The Stage 18 tooling lives only in the legacy tree that CI skips. The readiness check, hypothesis adjudication and phase seeding named by the intent-refinement skill (evaluate_phase_close_readiness, seed-next) are in the top-level pmbok/ package and scripts/orchestrate_pmbok.py. src/agent_learning/pmbok has no intent_refinement module. Their tests are in tests/pmbok, which CI excludes, and ADR-034 plans to delete that tree. Running Stage 18 therefore depends on code that is neither maintained in CI nor on the path ADR-034 sets out.
